reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 7 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the 76ers.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.
